_about: Mount Ravenmist (levels 16-26): outcast scouts who help each other and walk the mountain path, mountain trolls, the rock wyverns as elites, and the Wyvern Matriarch on the mountain top bringing down rockfalls and calling her brood.

helpers.shout: The scout gives a sharp whistle: outcasts close in!
The troll roars, and another answers from the rocks!

47250.name: wyvern matriarch
47250.long_desc: The Wyvern Matriarch crouches on the summit, wings half-spread, tail lashing.
47250.description: A grey-green wyvern twice the size of the others, her hide scarred by a century of storms and her barbed tail thick as a man. Every wyvern on Ravenmist hatched from her eggs.

phases.message: The Wyvern Matriarch screams, and the mountain answers!

abilities.name: Wing Buffet
abilities.telegraph: The Wyvern Matriarch rears up and beats her great wings!

abilities.name: Venom Sting
abilities.telegraph: The Wyvern Matriarch arches her barbed tail!

abilities.name: Diving Strike
abilities.telegraph: The Wyvern Matriarch launches into the air and wheels to dive!

patrols.why: an outcast scout walks the mountain path

bosses.why: the Wyvern Matriarch on the mountain top

mechanics.label: Rockfall
mechanics.why: rocks loosed by her wings: step out

mechanics.shout: The Wyvern Matriarch screams, and a rock wyvern dives out of the mist!
